title: Onboarding: plan dashes and hand off
text: /yoke onboard surveys existing work, helps the operator write goals and a high-level plan ready for parallel dashes as strategy docs through /yoke strategize (CURRENT-PLAN, a named initiative, or several), and configures only what those first dashes need. A plan is never final: once it is ready enough, the operator approves starting the first wave. Onboarding files no items; on that approval it hands off to /yoke steer naming those docs, which takes a seat per doc, vets and presents each dash for approval, assigns its done test, flow and QA plan when filing with --strategy-doc, and staffs the first wave. Project activation remains an item reaching done.
